faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Polish.

items.q: Does it handle Polish diacritics correctly?
items.a: Yes, letters like ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż appear correctly in both the text and what gets spoken aloud.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Polish back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Polish into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it get Polish grammar cases right?
items.a: Yes, it produces natural Polish with correct grammatical endings rather than a word-for-word rough translation.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need a Polish keyboard installed?
items.a: No, the app handles Polish letters automatically — no special keyboard needed.

items.q: Can I hear how the Polish translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.
